# Phaser runtime

- Version: 3.90.0
- Distribution: `phaser-arcade-physics.min.js`
- Source: npm package `phaser@3.90.0`
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE.md`

Only the production Arcade Physics bundle is vendored. The npm package, source maps,
and build sources are intentionally not retained to avoid adding over 100 MB of
build artifacts to the repository.
